$comment: Copy to tadoru.config.json. Every value here can also be set as an environment variable (TADORU_PORT, TADORU_SITES, ...). Environment variables win over this file.

retention.$comment: Raw event retention in months. The CNIL audience-measurement exemption caps this at 25. Values above 25 forfeit the consent exemption and the server will warn on boot.

session.$comment: Inactivity gap that ends a session, in minutes.

admin.$comment: Never commit a password. Set TADORU_ADMIN_PASSWORD in the environment instead; the server refuses to start without it.
